steps.content: [Flashback - EDGE Hall]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The scope of information you're interested in spans quite a range of categories, Chief, and the access permissions involved are... let's call it a labyrinth. My current module set isn't really built to navigate that gracefully. Fortunately, there's a dedicated institution designed to field requests like yours.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: EDGE has granted you a special information security clearance, so you'll now have high-level access to the <color=#fb9259>DisCity Central Library</color>. Beyond borrowing books or films you might enjoy, you'll be able to pull extensive backups of EDGE data.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You'll also find exceptional professionals there who can provide the help you need. I'm confident they'll earn your trust.
[Flashback End - Central Library]

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Let's see here... you're requesting Nirvana Group Comprehensive Import and Export Records, Investigation into the N.F. 114 Council Massacre, Ring Research Institute Technology Breach Compilation...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: These files are all classified at very high levels. Accessing them will leave a record, and the relevant entities—Nirvana, the Public Security Bureau, the Ring Research Institute—will be notified immediately. Are you sure that's alright?

<size=42>Linda</size>
Ph.D. Candidate in History, College of Humanities, DisCity United University
Central Library Resident Researcher

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm just worried if they find out you're looking into sensitive material like this, it might bring trouble your way...
A hint of concern crosses her face as her eyes move to Celine, her professor and advisor, who's next to you.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Will it cause trouble for you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have nothing to hide. Let them know. I don't care.
Jump

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Oh, no, not at all! All information management here follows proper procedure. Plus, we're just research scholars, historians. We've got no resources, no influence. Nobody's going to bother with people like us.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: It's just that your position is far more sensitive. If anything were to...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's even less reason to worry if it's just about me. It'll be okay, really.
end

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, your professor herself has said it: historians must keep a neutral, objective stance. Don't trouble yourself too much on my account.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now then, has that stance of yours tilted a little in my favor, Linda?
Linda instinctively claps a hand over her mouth, then gives her head a small tap.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Ah, sorry. Someone with zero political instincts like me shouldn't be presuming to second-guess your actions.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: But Professor did say you're different from the rest, that you're a friend to us. So, think of that just now as a friend being concerned. It doesn't compromise our academic position. Right, Professor?
As usual, she looks to Celine for guidance, and her advisor answers with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Your professor would also like to remind you: the fourth draft of your thesis is due in three days. I trust you've gotten through all the feedback, right?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Shoot—!! So sorry, I won't disturb you two any longer. I'm going now. Bye!
The young scholar scurries away hurriedly, flustered. She stumbles just a little as she crosses the threshold, until her figure melts into the brightness beyond.

steps.speaker: Option
options: You've got a remarkable student there, Professor.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Indeed. Of all the students I've had the privilege of teaching, she's the finest, and the most persistent. I'm counting on her to carry on my work someday.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I imagine the teacher deserves some credit for that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Linda's told me more than once how much she looks up to you. Best decisions of her life, she says. Both joining the history department and finding you as her advisor.
The words draw a smile from her.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Come now, Chief. Every time you show up with that flattering tongue of yours, I know you've come fishing for information. But... your voice sounds especially forced today. And you look utterly worn out.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Did something go wrong with EDGE?
Her smile settles into something gentler, her eyes warm with earnest concern.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I really can't hide a single thing from you, can I, Professor?
[Flashback - EDGE Hall]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Celine Fabius is a scholar of considerable renown in academic circles. She also serves, by EDGE's commission, as our city-state's specially appointed <color=#fb9259>chronicler</color>, in charge of collecting, recording, enriching, and preserving our history from every conceivable angle.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Her family holds deep roots in Paradeisos, which has left her with no shortage of connections. Yet despite her abundant resources, she maintains the integrity and restraint expected of a chronicler and witness. Quite admirable, if you ask me.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The professor's grasp of DisCity's history—as well as the social, economic, and political currents beneath it—runs deep. Her standing is unimpeachable. I do hope she'll provide the assistance you require.
[Flashback End - Central Library]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That EDGE meeting... Everything you warned me about all came true. They have absolutely no intention of letting go of BR-003.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: 04's almost certainly from Nirvana. Talks a fine game, but all that's running through their head is Hypercubes and profit margins. Honestly, them taking a jab at me while they're at it is whatever. Big corporations have always had it out for me. But what's everyone else's excuse?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've got 05, who talks in circles, slippery as an eel. No idea who's backing them, but they've clearly got weight to throw around. Everything they calculate comes wrapped in all this lofty "city-state interest" language.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then there's 06, who's basically dead weight and just goes along with whatever. And 08 didn't even show. All she left was one vote in my favor. How is that supposed to count as "support"? If she'd actually been there, she could've at least helped me chew them out!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: 01, 02, and 03 claim they won't participate directly. But at an EDGE vote of this level, that's simply not possible—they'd already made up their minds long before. They never would've delegated the decision otherwise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Still, out of all eight of them, the loudest and by far the most annoying is <color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color>.
Celine listens to you with a tender look in her eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Theoretical experiments. Professional assessments. They have the nerve to brush off a threat as blatant as a Black Ring, and all they ever have to say for themselves is "research"—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see it now. This whole "scientific rationality" routine is just a front. 07's real job is to cover for the rest of them, dressing up every greedy, self-serving agenda in respectable clothes.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...So. You came storming in here to borrow sensitive materials because you needed an outlet for all that anger. You wanted word to get out, to let them know you're furious, that you intend to investigate, to retaliate... You wanted to rattle them a little, I suppose?
She cocks her head, a teasing smile hovering at the corners of her mouth. Now that she's summarized your rant so neatly, it makes your recent actions feel a bit immature all of a sudden.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Ahem. That was part of it, yes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not naive enough to think borrowing "sensitive data" like this will actually get me anywhere. Those people wouldn't stash genuinely damaging intelligence somewhere an outsider like me can just reach and grab. And even if I did find something, who knows how much of it is actually planted by them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That said, I do believe coming here will get me what I'm actually after.
You turn your gaze directly to her.

steps.speaker: Option
options: —Through you, that is. Head Librarian Celine.

steps.content: You look at Celine Fabius.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've heard rumors about your memory, that you've mastered nearly every record in the Central Library, plus classified intelligence passed down through generations of chroniclers. So please, tell me everything you know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How did BR-003 become a catastrophe weapon? Why wasn't the same process applied to the other Black Rings? What exactly makes its nature so "unique"? Does DisCity have the technology to lift it into the sky and to hide it at will? Keep it hidden from the Underground's eyes?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That and, how many factions are tangled up behind it? Beyond the rational excuses on the surface, beyond the motives I can already see, are there deeper connections? Do they all feed into the positions those EDGE representatives take? Are those factions controlling EDGE itself?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Please, Professor. Tell me the truth.

steps.content: Celine holds your gaze, listening quietly, giving you her utmost attention. When your questions finally taper off, she lets her eyes fall, gathering her thoughts.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: My, those are bold questions. A few of those statements, should they ever leave this room, would stir up quite the storm in Eastside.
The professor's tone, sincere and tender, never fails to hearten you. More importantly, though, is her expression right now, which you've seen before. Your words have intrigued her.
An opening like this absolutely cannot be wasted.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not going to sit around and wait. If the representatives' leanings decide whether my proposal passes, and they love hiding behind "scientific rationality," then that's where I'll hit them first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell me everything there is to know about <color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color>. I know they're deeply tied to the Ring Research Institute, and it's the only institution directly bound to BR-003 as well. You and the Institute both fall under United University, and you hold a senior position in the College of Humanities. You have to know what's really going on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want their real motives for clinging so desperately to the Black Ring. The interests at play, the entanglements, and so on. At the next EDGE meeting, I'll tear down the <color=#fb9259>banner of science</color> they're hiding behind and force them to make the truly <color=#fb9259>rational</color> choice.
Celine hears out your impassioned words with a gentle smile, letting your enthusiasm crest and ebb. When you've finally wound down, she leans forward just a little.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: You flatter me, Chief. In terms of influence, research funding, student numbers, institutional standing... the College of Humanities can hardly hold a candle to the College of Science, let alone to its crown jewel, the Ring Research Institute. The Institute's status has nearly eclipsed United University itself. I have no standing to intervene.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: And in any case, for security reasons, the identities of EDGE's highest representatives are kept strictly confidential. How could a simple scholar like myself possibly hope to catch a glimpse of such things?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: If it is information you want, I must ask you to go through the Central Library's proper channels. Most of the time, our role is simply to listen and record. As observers, we are bound to remain fair and impartial. I can't very well undermine institutional protocol by always giving you backdoor access, now can I?
Her gaze finds yours, and her tone drops into something gentler. She offers a tender smile that feels equal parts apology and regret. You know exactly what she's trying to say.
—Great. All that performance for nothing. Looks like it's time for some verbal back-and-forth.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Earning her support will be no simple task. Celine Fabius is not one to choose sides lightly, after all. That objectivity and spotless integrity are the bedrock of her reputation.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: There's also... some commentary on record. A scattering of assessments, if you will. She's said to have a rather distinctive perspective: truth, in her view, is a precious resource. Not something to be handed out freely. The word people use is... "shrewd." Extremely shrewd. If you want information from her, you'll need to go prepared with something of your own.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: For your reference, of course.
[Exit Flashback]
Held by her tender gaze, you correct your posture, settle obediently into your seat, and step into the negotiation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand your position. Perhaps I should put it another way—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell me about the dynamics within United University. Just name a few key people, the sort of things you'd hear in passing. I can chase down the leads myself, do my own digging.
Celine takes a moment to consider before giving a slow shake of her head.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: The College of Humanities commands little respect, I'm afraid, and I've been buried in my own research. I wouldn't be much help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then... could you at least get me inside the university? I'd just stick close to you. That way, I can skip most of the security checks and slip in without raising any eyebrows.
A soft sigh escapes her as her eyes fall.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: I'm simply a fragile lady who so rarely leaves home. Travel would hardly suit my condition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... all I'm asking for is the truth! As a historian, isn't it your duty to bring truth to the people? To pass it on to those who come after?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: The deeper one wades into history, the more one understands: truth is a blade with two edges. It cuts your enemies, certainly, but it threatens you just as readily.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: At this particular moment, I would strongly caution against wading too deep.
She is truly flawless and unyielding. You've just witnessed the full artistry of a Paradeisian who navigates people like a second language.
But you've known her long enough. You didn't walk into this unprepared.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Of course, I'd never expect to get something for nothing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You mentioned your interest in the West District's development to me before. The people there hold a deep distrust of Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I happen to have a few friends on the inside. If I were to make introductions...
Something suddenly flickers within her eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They might just be willing to set aside their prejudices and share some interesting stories with you.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...Do elaborate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The truth behind the High Tower Black Ring. Rustfire's buried history. The things that never make it into the official record... Firsthand accounts. The real story. Wouldn't you want—

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Deal.

Her hand flashes down onto yours, swift as a shadow and entirely at odds with the lazy Paradeisos elegance she wears so well. Then, as if she fears you'll slip away, her next words come rushing out in a quickfire briefing.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: EDGE identities are an absolute red line. BR-003, too, is classified at the highest levels. Under no circumstances can I disclose either to you through unofficial channels. If you truly wish to investigate, you must earn the proper clearances yourself.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: That said, the Ring Research Institute's organizational structure and key personnel are all publicly accessible. Your current clearance already grants you access. What I can offer is a way to study them all thoroughly without leaving a trace. Without anyone ever knowing you looked.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: As for the forces lurking behind them, the ones with agendas that will never see the light of day, and what exactly those agendas entail...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Two days from now, the College of Science will host a private <color=#fb9259>project symposium</color>, open only to its most valued benefactors. They'll be unveiling certain unpublicized research and discussing avenues for further investment.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: I can furnish you with intelligence on the venue. If you can find a way to infiltrate under a suitable cover, I believe it would advance your investigation considerably.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: That is what I can offer at present. Would this be of use to you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Very much so. Please, tell me more about—

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Wonderful. Then, everything you mentioned just now. I want all of it. The people, the clippings, old logs, on-site surveys, the victims' families, and their personal effects. I trust you'll see to it that everything is arranged.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Consider what I've just given you the "deposit." Once you've made the arrangements and I've completed my interviews, I'll provide you with further intelligence. So... no backing out now.
The speed of her turnaround is nothing short of remarkable. You—

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...I feel like I just walked right into that.
So much for being a neutral, uninvolved chronicler?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Hehe, whatever gave you that idea? I was simply moved by your earnestness, Chief. This is a fair exchange, nothing more.
Her hand slips free of yours. Just like that, the poised and serene professor returns, although the sleeve lifted to her mouth can't quite disguise the delight still dancing in her gaze.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Truth holds an irresistible pull for any chronicler. We pursue it above all else. Life itself included.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Well now... I trust in your integrity, Chief. After this fair exchange, I have every confidence you'll conduct yourself properly. And as for me...

Her hand quickly slips from yours, and the professor immediately eases back into her seat, looking perfectly poised and beautifully serene once more. She holds your gaze now with a deeply soft, remarkably steady warmth.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: If it's for the sake of truth, a chronicler will stop at nothing.
end
Before you can even begin to formulate an answer, she's already sprung into action, positively luminous with a surge of bright, bustling enthusiasm.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Oh my, I'll have my hands full now! Field interviews... Should I start with Donald or Matilda? I've heard Mr. Samuel keeps quite the extensive records as well. Chief, could you arrange a few introductions for me today? How many can you line up?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Professor!! Not again!! The Quinn banquet is tonight. Have you forgotten? Someone might commission a book from you! That's real funding we're talking about! If we can't pull in more support, our research budget is going to hit rock bottom again!

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Not to worry. I can always resolve that with a quick visit to the Fabius estate. It can wait. But you've reminded me of something... Linda, why don't you go and assist Chief?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ${PlayerName} is unfamiliar with the university, and there's no telling what complications might arise once he's inside those halls. I'd feel far more at ease knowing you were there.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} is unfamiliar with the university, and there's no telling what complications might arise once she's inside those halls. I'd feel far more at ease knowing you were there.

steps.content: Linda stands there thunderstruck, mouth hanging open.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Didn't you just say my fourth draft is due in three days?! And besides, humanities students aren't even allowed inside those buildings!
At her student's heart-wrenching accusation, Celine hides her face in her hands, sorrow pooling in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Alas, the history department's halls grow ever emptier. Of all my students, you're the only one I can truly count on now. But if you're really unwilling...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: W-well... if you really need me to...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Come now, when would I not need you? Oh! I've also prepared a miner's outfit. It's deliberately weathered, authentic grime and all. Does it suit me? Think it'll help me blend in?

The graceful, cultivated, perpetually unflappable "highborn academic" standing before you now strips away the mask, letting slip a genuine, heartfelt longing for a world her Paradeisos peers would never bother to acknowledge.
She's going to fit in perfectly. They will like her.
You get to your feet and say your goodbyes. After two steps, though, you stop and look back over your shoulder.
Linda has already gone, scratching her head. Only Celine is left, her eyes still on you. Catching your backward glance, she answers it with a smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How much do you know about the <color=#fb9259>Underground</color>, Professor?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Ah, now... that would be an entirely new consultation. I'd need fresh intelligence in exchange for that one.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: One thing at a time, Chief. First, your opening venture. I'll be here, waiting to hear every detail when you return.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Every step you take is already pulling at the threads of history, sending ripples outward... I wish you a smooth journey ahead.

You walk out of the Central Library and look up. Sunlight bathes the world in perfect gold, the sky is blue as ever, dappled with clouds. You know your true target is up there, hanging far overhead. It might be out of sight, but never out of mind.

Your gaze returns to earth. Two blocks away, ringed by high walls and green canopies, lies DisCity United University, where the Ring Research Institute resides, where the "symposium" awaits. That is your next stage.
Professor Celine's help was essential, but that alone won't be nearly enough. You need your own kind of preparation.
United University. Ring Research Institute. Science. Genius...

A face comes to mind. You fish out your terminal and punch in an encrypted code. A strange, indescribable ringtone sounds in your ear. The line opens before the second ring. You feel the smile creeping in and let it come.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Hey there, our beloved genius hero. Got time to look over a new script?

steps.content:
<size=40><color=#9C19D9>Pixel</color><color=#F6EF2F>'s</color><color=#1A45DF> Private Channel</color></size>
<color=#F03679><size=50>[Voice of Pix]</size></color>
<size=40><color=#2AFFCC>Makes Its</color><color=#2AFF4C> Grand Comeback!!!</color></size>

Pixel: Helloooooo, my most distinguished guests of the Ring Research Institute symposium. How's your thesis coming along?! Don't you panic, don't you fret! Pixel's Master Ghostwriting Channel is back to haunt your deadlines!

psojfhga:
Oh great. The anonymous paper pusher slithered back into my feed. I've blocked you like five times already, what kind of dark magic algorithm are you running? When's the raid?

Pixel:
Oh shush, you wound me! I poured in all this blood, sweat, and maniacal cackling for you sweethearts, y'know! As for security? Pfft. This lady just gave the whole system a MAJOR, and I mean MAJOR, glow-up!

Pixel:
Servers have been relocated somewhere so undisclosed! DisMyth looks like a Caesar cipher now. Nearly 30 years of United University theses are stored in our databanks!

ioghiahi:
Can you do "System Design of Inspection Robots Based on Large Language Models"? Everyone else ghosted me.

Pixel:
Hehe. Radio silence means they saw "AI" in the title and ran screaming for the hills. Adorable. But graduation projects like this are my comfort food! AI encapsulation, threshold models, and coupling inspection path data? That's my breakfast, lunch, and late-night snack.

Pixel:
Ooh! And speaking of which, sounds like the symposium's sniffing around the same direction this year! But seating's tighter than a miser's wallet, and Quinn's already sprawled across half the chairs. So if you didn't snag an invite, don't you DARE mope about it! Just waltz right over to yours truly and buy the no-filler, all-killer essentials version!

Pixel:
<color=#fb9259>Academic problems? Pixel's got you covered!</color>
